author: andlo
name: WhiteNoise
description: An ambient sound machine for OVOS - white/brown noise, rain, ocean waves, fan noise, looped for sleep or focus. A surprisingly common voice-assistant feature (Alexa/Google both have it) that's missing from the OVOS ecosystem (checked before starting). Needs a small library of loopable ambient tracks, sourced the same way as ovos-skill-sound-like's bundled sounds (CC0-verified).
